scope: AIOC-only preimplementation contract closure; no Multiversal-app PCV runtime implementation, external networking activation, hosted signaling, STUN/TURN purchase, Android permission mutation or package release

source_snapshot.historical_candidate: Multiversal-app PR #775 / pre-audit PCV-03 exact-candidate lineage

authority_invariants.encrypted_transport_is_not_identity: A successful ICE/DTLS/SCTP/DataChannel connection proves an encrypted transport to the negotiated peer endpoint. It does not by itself prove canonical subjectId, deviceId, Campaign membership, role, entitlement or Session authority.
authority_invariants.canonical_identity: A3 StableSubjectSession plus PCV-I01A device proof-of-possession owns authenticated subject/device binding.
authority_invariants.invitation_and_membership: A3 invitation + A5 membership composition from PCV-I01B remains authoritative. Transport metadata never mints membership or role.
authority_invariants.session_authority: A5 Session shell/immutable launch snapshot plus P9 ordered Session history remains authority. Transport connectionId/fingerprint/SDP/ICE state is context only.
authority_invariants.entitlement: EntitlementPort evaluates the authenticated subject. Client self-asserted entitlement/grant claims are ignored.
authority_invariants.family_safety: MIB-17/SMB-14 gates invitations and communication but never grants Campaign or hidden-information authority.

signaling_boundary.answer_secret_rule: The answer does not echo invitationBearer. offerId plus a digest of the canonical offer-without-bearer binds the answer to the signaling exchange.
signaling_boundary.inference_rule: Before A3 authentication and invitation recipient resolution succeed over the encrypted channel, signaling may reveal only opaque routing/lifetime fields and WebRTC SDP/ICE material required to establish transport. No Campaign, Session, subject, pack/rules, entitlement or projection metadata is disclosed.
signaling_boundary.sensitive_material_rule: Manual offer/answer strings are sensitive because the offer carries a bearer and both SDP descriptions may expose ICE/network metadata. They are never written to durable product history, telemetry, analytics, diagnostic bundles, crash attachments or application logs.
signaling_boundary.ui_handling: Treat manual signaling text as a secret surface: no automatic logging, no automatic clipboard copy, explicit user action for copy/paste, redact from screenshots/diagnostic exports where feasible, and discard application-held plaintext when the exchange completes/expires.
signaling_boundary.strict_decode: Signal tokens have strict field allow-lists, bounded encoded size, exact kind/SDP agreement, exact signalVersion and validated expiry. Unknown fields or malformed base64/JSON fail closed.

phase_order: host issues fresh transport-binding challenge nonce
joining client proves current PCV-I01A device credential possession and identifies a current A3 StableSubjectSession
host verifies credential->device->subject and StableSubjectSession subject mapping
joining client presents invitation bearer over the encrypted channel
host resolves A3 invitation recipient to the same authenticated subject and evaluates current invitation/family policy
host evaluates current A5 membership/role and entitlement state
host issues a PeerAuthorizationBinding scoped to this transport instance and authority epoch
only then disclose protected Session requirements/state
challenge_binding: current remote DTLS fingerprint digest derived from negotiated SDP
peer_identity_binding.device_proof_rule: The client signs the canonical challenge with the non-exportable PCV-I01A device credential. The host verifies the registered public verifier and current A3 mapping; possession of deviceId text is insufficient.
peer_identity_binding.dtls_fingerprint_rule: DTLS fingerprint continuity is bound into the proof transcript as transport context, but fingerprint/SDP/ICE values never become canonical user identity or Campaign authorization.
peer_identity_binding.reconnect_rule: Every new/restarted peer transport performs a fresh challenge and revalidates current A3 session/device, invitation/resume credential as applicable, A5 membership state/version, permissions version, family communication policy and authority epoch. A prior transport binding is never copied forward.

application_protocol.schema_version_rule: Every envelope kind has an explicit positive integer schemaVersion. Decoder dispatches by negotiated protocol major/minor + kind + schemaVersion; unsupported major/schema fails closed.
application_protocol.unknown_field_rule: Protocol v1 uses closed top-level and payload schemas. Unknown fields are rejected unless a future negotiated schema explicitly defines an extensions object.
application_protocol.decoder_rule: Check encoded byte size before JSON parse, parse JSON only, validate exact object shape/types/enums/ranges/string lengths/array lengths and reject duplicate or noncanonical identifiers before handing data to any owner-domain coordinator.
application_protocol.malformed_input_rule: Invalid input is never silently swallowed. If it is safe to reply, emit one rate-limited inference-safe protocol-error carrying only a generic code/correlation id; oversized/flooding or repeated malformed pre-auth input closes the channel without reflecting attacker-controlled content.
application_protocol.no_echo_rule: Safe errors never echo raw message content, secret values, hidden identifiers or whether a protected Campaign/subject exists.

bounded_work_policy.negotiated_frame_rule: Effective maximum is min(65536, RTCSctpTransport.maxMessageSize when finite and nonzero). A peer advertising/negotiating a smaller limit wins.
bounded_work_policy.backpressure_rule: At/above high-water, stop producing nonessential/prefetch frames and wait for bufferedamountlow before continuing. At hard limit or bounded application-queue overflow, fail closed/close the transport rather than allocate without bound.
bounded_work_policy.batching_rule: Event batching is bounded by both event count and encoded frame size; split into additional ordered batches rather than exceed the effective maximum.
bounded_work_policy.security_reason: Bounds apply before owner-domain command execution so malformed/hostile peers cannot turn protocol parsing or queued sends into unbounded memory/work.

cryptographic_randomness.secret_requirement: Invitation, resume, auth challenge, offer id and other security-sensitive nonce/bearer generation uses an operating-system/Web Crypto CSPRNG only.
cryptographic_randomness.allowed_browser_primitive: crypto.getRandomValues (or a native cryptographic primitive exposed through an approved platform port)
cryptographic_randomness.identifier_primitive: crypto.randomUUID may be used for non-secret identifiers when available; identifiers do not substitute for bearer entropy.
cryptographic_randomness.forbidden_fallback: Math.random, timestamps, predictable counters or concatenations of non-cryptographic randomness are forbidden for secrets/nonces. Missing CSPRNG support fails closed.

capability_and_entitlement_handshake.disclosure_stage: Only after peer identity, invitation recipient, family invitation policy and base membership authorization succeed.
host_requirements_source: current authorityEpoch from canonical Session authority
current role-safe projection scope from current A5 authorization
current host EntitlementPort decision/version references for the authenticated subject
capability_and_entitlement_handshake.symbolic_version_rule: `current`, `latest`, mutable aliases or unversioned pack/rules selectors are invalid for launch/session compatibility. PCV runtime must resolve them to exact immutable versions before A5 launch snapshot creation; existing PCV-02 symbolic values are authoring inputs only.

client_measurement.rule: The joining client independently measures its installed state from local package/runtime registries after receiving authorized exact requirements. It must not populate proof fields by copying the host offer/requirements object.
evidence_fields: locally installed pack stable ids/versions/content digests
client_measurement.source_reference_rule: Evidence includes local registry/source references or locally computed digests sufficient for the adapter to prove measurement occurred; host-provided values are comparison targets only.

capability_and_entitlement_handshake.host_entitlement_rule: The authoritative executor independently calls current EntitlementPort for the authenticated canonical subject. Client-supplied grant counts/digests/entitlement claims are non-authoritative and ignored.
capability_and_entitlement_handshake.accept_rule: Join proceeds only when protocol/schema compatibility, exact locally measured pack/rules/runtime requirements, host entitlement decision, current A5 membership and projection scope all agree. Mismatch is fail-closed and role-safe.
capability_and_entitlement_handshake.epoch_rule: authorityEpoch is host-canonical state sent after authorization; the client acknowledges it but cannot prove or choose the epoch by echoing it.

family_and_communication_policy.invitation_gate: PCV-I01B invitation-specific MIB-17/SMB-14 policy gate remains required before acceptance.
family_and_communication_policy.communication_gate: Before authorizing ongoing Session DataChannel application traffic for a subject, evaluate MIB-17 capability `communication` and SMB-14 sender/target blocking semantics. Deny/unsatisfied guardian policy/blocked relationship leaves transport unauthorized and closes or limits it to safe recovery/error exchange.
family_and_communication_policy.revalidation: Re-evaluate communication authorization when the peer reconnects, A3 session changes, membership/permissions version changes, family policy version changes or a block decision changes.
family_and_communication_policy.no_authority_escalation: Guardian approval may satisfy family-policy capability only and never grants Campaign membership, GM authority, hidden visibility, canonical mutation authority or entitlement.

baseline_zero_service.signaling: user-mediated offer/answer exchange; no hosted signaling service required
baseline_zero_service.scope: required baseline for local/same-LAN or otherwise directly reachable peers
baseline_zero_service.limitation: Direct host candidates cannot traverse every NAT/firewall topology; failure to connect is not an authorization failure.

assisted_adapter.configuration_rule: No public STUN/TURN hostname is hard-coded into canonical protocol or policy. ICE service endpoints/credentials come from replaceable configuration/service adapters.
assisted_adapter.selection_rule: ICE may try configured direct/STUN candidates and use TURN relay only when needed/allowed; relay choice does not change Session/identity authority.
assisted_adapter.credential_rule: TURN credentials are bounded/ephemeral secrets and follow PCV-I02 SecretStore/no-log rules.
assisted_adapter.privacy_rule: STUN/TURN use and ICE candidates are network metadata; logs/diagnostics use redacted path class and safe failure codes, not raw SDP/candidate addresses.

governed_timeout_policy.a3_invitation_expiry: Owned by A3 invitation policy/record and supplied explicitly. Transport code never invents a 24-hour invitation lifetime.
governed_timeout_policy.policy_rule: These are versioned product defaults, not scattered constants. The authoritative host may apply a stricter configured value; it may not extend a manual offer beyond the owning A3 invitation expiry.
governed_timeout_policy.expiry_behavior: Expired signaling/auth exchanges fail closed, destroy in-memory bearer material and require a fresh offer/challenge. They do not mutate invitation/membership state merely because transport timed out.

android_local_network_permission.trigger: When an Android installed client targeting Android 17/API 37+ will discover or communicate with LAN-local peers/host ICE candidates, request ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK at runtime before that local-network operation.
android_local_network_permission.declaration: Declare ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK only when targetSdk/feature use requires it; do not add broad local-network access merely for dormant capability.
android_local_network_permission.denial: Denial/revocation is handled as a transport-path-unavailable condition with clear retry/settings guidance; never reinterpret it as authentication/membership denial and never bypass the OS permission.
android_local_network_permission.assisted_path: A future privacy-preserving system-mediated picker or relay-only path may avoid broad LAN permission when it does not access the local network; transport adapter decides from actual path requirements.
android_local_network_permission.current_repo_rule: PCV-I03 records the trigger only. Android manifest/runtime permission implementation remains blocked until the authorized PCV runtime tranche.

external_sanity_checks.use: WebRTC data channels are DTLS-protected, but peer/user identity requires an independent binding; SDP fingerprints and signaling are security context, not application authorization.
ICE candidate addresses can reveal local network/location/fingerprinting information and are exchanged with the communicating party.
Data channels buffer outbound data and have negotiated message-size limits; absent max-message-size defaults to 64 KiB.
bufferedAmount/bufferedamountlow provide the standard application backpressure signal.
ICE supports host, STUN-derived server-reflexive and TURN-relayed candidates; deployments may disable STUN/TURN by configuration while retaining replaceability.
TURN supplies a relay when direct NAT traversal is impossible and is normally used after direct paths are attempted.
Treat long-lived bidirectional messages as untrusted; schema validate, bound payload size, rate limit, apply backpressure and avoid logging auth/session secrets.
Apps targeting Android 17/API 37+ need ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK runtime permission for LAN discovery/communication and must handle denial/revocation.

runtime_boundary.next_runtime_destination: PCV-03C only after PCV-I04 through PCV-I06 predecessor closure
